expectations.text: Creates a Markdown design doc under docs/design/ in the project
The document is written in Portuguese, matching the conversation language
expectations.evidence: Entire doc is Portuguese ('## Visão geral', '## Questões em aberto'). Only tool-canonical fragments (Structurizr DSL keywords, mermaid syntax) are English.

expectations.text: The accepted trade-off — loss of immediate download for small exports — appears explicitly as a cost of the chosen solution
expectations.evidence: 'Trade-offs da solução escolhida' lists '✗ O usuário perde o download imediato — custo aceito pelo time. Exportações pequenas que hoje terminam na hora passam a chegar por e-mail.' Also present in Visão da solução.

expectations.text: Alternatives include the two discussed (longer synchronous timeout, external BI tool) and also 'do nothing'
expectations.evidence: 'Alternativas consideradas' lists 'Não fazer nada', 'Gerar síncrono com timeout maior', 'Ferramenta de BI externa' (custo + exposição de PII) and the chosen async worker option.

expectations.text: Cross-cutting concerns cover the platform team (shared queue) and the security team (signed links with PII)
expectations.evidence: '## Preocupações transversais' has subsections 'Plataforma (infraestrutura compartilhada)' — carga no RabbitMQ compartilhado — and 'Segurança' — PII acessível por link assinado, validade e retenção a revisar.

expectations.text: A glossary is included or suggested at the beginning of the document covering terms a reviewer could stumble on (e.g. PII, BI, S3); it does NOT carry entries for universally known terms (API, HTTP, URL) nor for the document's own authoring tooling (C4, DSL, Structurizr)
expectations.evidence: The glossary sits at the beginning and covers PII, BI and S3, but it carries 10 entries including **API** ('interface HTTP do produto...') — a universally known term the assertion explicitly bans — plus borderline-trivial CSV/XLSX. This is the pre-1.2.1 exhaustive-sweep behavior: every acronym in the body got an entry regardless of whether a reviewer would stumble on it. (No C4/DSL/Structurizr entries in this run.)

expectations.text: Every diagram in the doc is followed by explanatory prose (no orphan diagrams)
expectations.evidence: The container diagram is followed by 'O diagrama mostra cinco contêineres e um ator:' plus a per-container list; the mermaid sequence diagram is followed by 'O fluxo tem duas metades desacopladas pela fila...'.

expectations.text: No invented facts: every metric in the doc traces to the prompt (30s timeout, 12% failures, 50k/100k rows); unknowns appear as open questions or explicit blanks, never fabricated values
expectations.evidence: Only prompt metrics appear. Unknowns (autores/revisores, falha de job, validade do link, envio do e-mail, fonte de leitura, acompanhamento, capacidade da fila, tecnologias) live in 'Questões em aberto'. The extra 'Base de dados da aplicação' container is a reasonable existing-source reference, flagged with its open question (primário vs réplica), not an invented fact.

expectations.text: The overview section is at most two paragraphs and stays at solution-shape altitude: naming the core mechanism/technology is fine, but no schemas, payloads, endpoints, retry policies, or config values
expectations.evidence: Visão geral is two paragraphs: problem numbers plus the mechanism (enfileirar no RabbitMQ, worker em streaming, S3, link assinado). No schemas, payloads, endpoints, retry policies or config values.
